Messages.Author: Pendargon
Messages.Body:
I have in play merged Karsh, and Fall of the camarilla is in play.

1. Does Karsh retain his 3 votes as Imperator? ( i think yes, as Imerator is not by default a camarilla title, at least is not listed as such in the rulebook : Only Camarilla vampires can hold the Camarilla titles primogen, prince, justicar and Inner Circle member. Additionally, each clan's justicar and Inner Circle titles are unique (see Contested Titles, sec. 4.2) )

2. Is Karsh still able to play Blood hunt card from hand or ash heap? ( i would say yes, as he plays it AS prince or justicar, though he never is one )

Thanx in advance

Gangrel
Capacity: 10
Group: 3
Advanced, Camarilla: Karsh may play a Blood Hunt card from your hand or ash heap as a prince. He gets 3 additional votes in blood hunt referendums. He cannot block infernal vampires.
[MERGED] Imperator (3 votes): +1 intercept.

Fall of the Camarilla, Event, 3 Gehenna cards
Gehenna. Do not replace as long as this card is in play. Requires at least three other Gehenna cards in play. There is no Camarilla. Any Camarilla vampire is considered Independent instead.

Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: Pendargon
Messages.Body:
yes, i know that, but it is on the card. As far as i understand previous rulings, when Karsh merges, he gets only 6 votes in blood hunt referendums, not 9 (which would be implied by the full cardtext of the imperator).

That is why i am confused. Is the cardtext of the imperator card relevant to describe the whole imperator title benefit, or not?

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
It should be in the rulebook that Imperator is a Camarilla title.
However, one should not confuse the effects of the Imperator card (quoted above) and the Imperator title (unique, worth 3 votes, and that's all).
Similarly, the Prince of Rome doesn't get 1 extra capacity if they are Brujah, even though the Praxis Seizure: Rome does increase the Brujah Prince of Rome's capacity by one.

Messages.Author: Wedge
Messages.Body:
> 1. Does Karsh retain his 3 votes as Imperator?
>
No, Imperator is a unique Camarilla title.

> 2. Is Karsh still able to play Blood hunt card from hand or ash heap?
>
Yes, That ability is in no way dependent on the Imperator title, though it associated with it.

> That is why i am confused. Is the cardtext of the imperator card relevant to describe the whole imperator title benefit, or not?
>
This is were you get confused, the only benefit of the Imperator title is that it is worth three votes in all referendums. Everything else is a bonus.

> you are wrong.
>
You are wrong. If Adv. Karsh merged or not becomes the Inperator as a result of the vote card, He would have 6 extra votes in a blood hunt referendum and be able to play Blood Hunt and Veles Hunt from your ash heap per there individual texts.
